Class UserDirectoryManager

java.lang.Object
ua.stetsenkoinna.config.UserDirectoryManager
public class UserDirectoryManager extends Object
The UserDirectoryManager class is responsible for managing the local directory structure used by the PetriObjModelPaint application.

This class automatically creates a hidden application directory under the user's home folder (typically ~/.PetriObjModelPaint) and ensures that all required subdirectories — such as configs, cache, logs, data, and tmp — are initialized and available.

It also provides utility methods for performing file operations (create, delete, check existence, resolve absolute paths, clear contents, etc.) within those directories.

Example usage:


 UserDirectoryManager manager = new UserDirectoryManager();
 Path configPath = manager.getFilePath("application.properties", AppDirectoryType.CONFIGS);

 if (!manager.fileExists("application.properties", AppDirectoryType.CONFIGS)) {
     manager.createFileIfMissing("application.properties", AppDirectoryType.CONFIGS);
 }
